title: Boundary-aware spectral kernel ridge regression on regular grids: exact band solves on the DST2 whole-sample-symmetric embedding for free-boundary BCCB systems, with preconditioned Anderson mixing for masked grids (iteration-4 hypothesis, F1 primary)
title_note: Title wording is softened per the hypothesis-gate gist: no 'exact-structure' novelty claim. 'Boundary-aware' and 'structured' wording only. 'Exact' appears ONLY as 'exact band solves' — i.e., exact (untruncated) solution of the banded/Toeplitz boundary system via classical formulas (Trench 66 / Gohberg-Semencul 67 / Stewart 73), never as an exactness claim for the overall free-boundary solve, whose residual is measured and gated at <= 1e-6.

primary_strategy.name: DST2-embedding exact/mixed boundary solver (refined S1)
primary_strategy.one_line: Replace the approximate rank-limited Woodbury boundary correction (which plateaued the corrected residual at ~1e2-1e3) with EXACT band/Toeplitz solves on the DST2 whole-sample-symmetric embedding form, making the w <= min(H,W)/8 regime structural (no rank budget to exhaust) and targeting measured median gap 47.36% -> >= 50% and residual 532.22 -> <= 1e-6.

evidence_chain: The binding failure of iteration-3 S1 was the residual clause: median corrected residual 532.2245 >> 1e-6 with per-grid plateaus 546.2021 (64x64) / 415.7885 (128x128) — i.e., ~1e2-1e3, never ~1e-6 — and the rank budget |T| = O(w(H+W)) (pooled median T_size 1233) is what plateaus it [INVALIDATED-HISTORY honest negatives; results/iter3/A1-boundary.json pooled block]. F1 replaces the rank-limited approximation with an exact band solve, so the residual gate becomes structurally reachable rather than truncation-limited.

The gap bar was NEARLY met: median w_design gap reduction 47.3574% vs the 50% bar (first clause FAILS by 2.64pp), while the DST2-class comparator already crosses it (DST2 pooled median gap reduction 61.62%, 129/141 rows improve; 24^3 DST2 median 95.06%) — DST2 is the empirically superior classical boundary-aware class on this regime [honest negatives; A1-boundary.json + analysis-iter3.json]. F1's construction lives in the DST2 class, so the >= 50% gap clause is targeted directly.

The DCT/DST 50%-capture consequence already HELD in iteration-3 (capture vs DST2 = 0.7467 on the 70-row positive-DST2 subset / 0.7284 all-75; both >= 50%), so S1 was NOT additionally disqualified by the consequence rule — the disqualification rests on the gap/residual/guard clauses that F1 is designed to fix [honest negative; analysis-iter3.json numbers_pack].

The w-claimable guard failed on 2 of 3 grids ({64_8: null, 128_16: true, 24_3: false}) because w_design = ceil(2.5*rho) = 10 exceeds min(H,W)/8 at 64x64 (8) and 24^3 (3) [honest negative; A1-boundary.json pooled.w_claimable_guard]. F1 removes the rank-budget origin of the guard (exact band solves need no O(w(H+W)) rank), and pre-commits a clamped w_design = min(ceil(2.5*rho), min(H,W)/8) so every grid in the pool satisfies the regime by construction — the residual clause independently falsifies, so the clamp cannot hide failure.

The 3D floor caveat is documented, not hidden: the 3D symmetric embedding is non-PSD on the tested kernels/grids (24^3 n_neg {matern32: 289, matern52: 4578, rbf: 7662}; 48^3 {0, 1468, 4222}; review.md Nexus note), so 3D rows carry n_neg disclosure and floored-spectrum handling with an a-posteriori floor-error bound (Graham 70) — the same convention already used for the non-PSD RBF torus Gram in iteration-2.
selection_justification.why_not_F2_primary: F2 (randomized-Nystrom-preconditioned Anderson mixing) targets the S2 rate failure (0.2374x/0.1560x/0.1624x speedups < 1.5x REFUTED bar; iters 278.5 vs 192.0; convergence 77.7% vs 100%) [honest negatives; results/iter3/A2-masked.json pooled block]. The failure is clearly in the preconditioning/mixing RATE (RMSE parity HOLDS: 0.3504163 vs 0.3504185), but there is no measured evidence that preconditioner replacement alone spans a 0.24x -> 3x swing (the A5 no-circulant-preconditioner ablation was omitted-budget-capped, so the preconditioner's marginal contribution was never measured), and the 1.5-3x tie band terminates in NOT-validated. F2 is therefore documented and carried as a contingent secondary arm (A2) with its own pre-registered S2' win rule, but it is NOT the primary hypothesis.
selection_justification.risk_statement: F1 is high-risk: iteration-3 rows show the residual after band correction concentrates ~0.8-0.95 in the interior (interior_res fraction), so the embedding MODEL error, not truncation, may dominate; if the exact band solve still leaves median relative residual > 1e-6, F1 is REFUTED by the pre-committed rule. This is exactly the intended falsifiability.

deferred_strategy.name: Masked-Gram acceleration via preconditioned Anderson mixing (refined S2) — documented, contingent secondary arm
deferred_strategy.one_line: Keep Anderson mixing (A5-essential), replace the identity/floored-torus preconditioner class of the spectral step with a randomized-Nystrom / deflation preconditioner of the masked Gram (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I), targeting >= 3x median speedup at KKT < 1e-6.
deferred_strategy.role: Not the primary hypothesis (see selection_justification.why_not_F2_primary). Executed within budget as arm A2 so the G6 line stays measured and the reviewer-fixed masked conventions (pool disclosure, tieband, cost-clause) are stated WITH evidence; A2 verdicts are reported honestly and do not gate F1's verdict.

fallback_strategy.name: Fallback repositioning: negative-result + tooling contribution
fallback_strategy.one_line: If F1 (and the A2/A3 lines) fail their gates again, the iteration-4 deliverable is explicitly a negative-result study with tooling, governed by the same pre-registered label table.
fallback_strategy.acceptance_rule: No positive win gate — acceptance = completeness of the honest-negative reporting (the 20-item honest-negatives list reported verbatim per results/analysis/analysis-iter3.json honest_negatives; pools disclosed with per-domain breakdowns; the tieband convention written down, including the literal no-tieband sensitivity row; container-forced reference deviations disclosed — iteration-3 template: three 24^3 dense-Cholesky attempts OOM-killed by the ~2 GB cgroup, executed reference = PCG-1e-8 container-forced deviation, A1 ref_attempts_log/ref_convention_notes) + tooling deliverables passing self-checks (boundary-controlled GRF generator A6 selfcheck pass; scaling A4; Anderson-essential ablation A5). Corpus/plan anchors: the reviewers' 'defensible but below qualifying-positive bar' note (Significance 3), the pre-registered label table governing all claims.

hypothesis_statement: On regular-grid KRR with stationary kernels (BCCB/BTTB class), the free-boundary boundary-correction problem and the masked-Gram solve problem admit the following falsifiable claims: (F1, primary) solving the boundary system of the DST2 whole-sample-symmetric embedding EXACTLY (banded/Toeplitz direct solves, no rank truncation) — rather than approximately via a rank-limited Woodbury correction — reaches median free-boundary gap reduction >= 50% with median relative system residual <= 1e-6 under a structurally enforced w <= min(H,W)/8, PLUS >= 50% capture of the DST2 comparator's own gap reduction; (F2, contingent/secondary) a randomized-Nystrom-preconditioned Anderson-mixing masked solver reaches >= 3x median wall-clock speedup vs standard PCG at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 with RMSE parity; (F3, fallback) if either gates fail, the deliverable is a complete negative-result + tooling study under the pre-registered label table.

F1_algorithm_sketch: 1. Embed: build the whole-sample symmetric (2H-1)x(2W-1) [3D: (2H-1)x(2W-1)x(2D-1)] first-column extension of the free-boundary BTTB kernel Gram in the DST2-class symmetric-convolution form (Martucci 45; DST2 is the empirically superior boundary-aware spectral class on this regime: pooled median gap reduction 61.62% vs BCCB, 129/141 rows improve [honest negative, A1-boundary.json]). NOT half-sample 2H reflective padding.

2. Spectral solve: diagonalize the embedded symmetric-boundary operator in the DST2 transform domain (O(N log N), scipy dstn); floor the spectrum at 0 (PSD projection) with n_negative_eigenvalues disclosed per grid/kernel and an a-posteriori negative-eigenvalue error bound applied per Graham 70 (3D WSS class is non-PSD: 24^3 n_neg {289, 4578, 7662}; 48^3 {0, 1468, 4222} — Nexus note).

3. Boundary system: the DST2 embedded solve's discrepancy from the free-boundary solve concentrates in the edge band of width w (measured iteration-3 w-sweep: band_res fraction 0.02-0.42 of the residual, interior 0.58-0.98 [honest negative]); assemble the boundary-band system.

4. EXACT band solve (the F1 replacement for the Woodbury step): solve the banded boundary system DIRECTLY — no rank truncation. 2D: exact symmetric-banded Cholesky/LU of the O(w(H+W)) boundary system (O(N_b w^2), N_b = O(w(H+W))), with 1D Toeplitz/Hankel chains available via the exact Trench 66 / Gohberg-Semencul 67 formulas (O(L^2) per chain) or the stabilized superfast Toeplitz solve of Stewart 73 (O(L log^2 L)) where budget permits; 3D: banded solve on the edge-band system with N_b = O(w(HW+HD+WD)); optional re-seeding via HSS direct structured solves (Ambikasaran 54) attempted-if-budget with an honest not-completed report if over-envelope.
5. Combine: alpha = alpha_embed - band_correction (exact band solve applied, no Woodbury rank budget).

6. w regime (structural): w_design = min(ceil(2.5*rho), min(H,W)/8) — pre-committed clamp so w <= min(H,W)/8 holds on EVERY grid by construction; the clamp is a documented design decision motivated by the iteration-3 guard failure {64_8: null, 128_16: true, 24_3: false} [honest negative]; the residual clause (<= 1e-6) is independent of the clamp and falsifies the strategy if the band model is insufficient.

7. w-sweep fail-fast: monotonic residual decay in w {1, ..., w_design} pre-registered; non-monotonic rows fail-fast and are recorded (iteration-3: 9 of 141 rows fail-fast, all 64x64 [honest negative]).

F1_parameters.rho: kernel range in grid units (4.0), w_design = min(ceil(2.5*rho), min(H,W)/8)
F1_parameters.sparse_direct_backend: banded Cholesky via scipy.linalg.solve_banded / Trench-Gohberg-Semencul 1D Toeplitz chains (scipy.linalg.solve_toeplitz, O(L^2)); Stewart 73 superfast attempted-if-budget

strategy_spec.F1_complexity: O(N log N) DST2 spectral step + O(N_b w^2) exact band step (O(N k^2)-type band term with k = w, disclosed; N_b = O(w(H+W)) 2D / O(w(HW+HD+WD)) 3D); memory O(N + N_b w). The exact band solve has NO rank budget to exhaust, so the O(N log N) + low-rank cost regime is structural, not budget-constrained.
F2_algorithm_sketch: 1. Shared masked-Gram system (spelled identically in the plan and the arm): (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I) w = y_m — the SAME system standard PCG solves (results/iter2/T1b convention; canonical relative residual per-field 4.69e-9..9.81e-9 at tol 1e-8).

2. Retain Anderson mixing, window m = 5 (A5 ablation: ESSENTIAL — without it the solver stalls at the 500-iteration ceiling with relative residual ~4.1e5-7.4e5; with it, 259-384 iterations to ~1e-6 [honest negative, results/iter3/A5-ablation.json]).

3. Replace the identity/floored-torus preconditioner class with a randomized-Nystrom / deflation preconditioner of the masked Gram (Frangella-Tropp-Udell 71: sketch the low-rank part of the SPD system (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I), tunable sketch size k pre-registered (k disclosed; small-k sweep {64, 128, 256} where budget permits), deflation of the dominant eigenspace).
4. Termination: KKT residual r_t := (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I) w - y_m, relative norm, IDENTICAL convention to the PCG reference; primary gate < 1e-6 (matched secondary 1e-8).
5. RMSE parity judged on the SAME valid-cell evaluation domain as T1b (mask-excluded valid cells).

F2_parameters.tasks: synthetic 2D 64x64/128x128, random masks 10/30/50% + block masks; Kaplan SST v2 36x72 (polar caps, land, random) future-blind as iteration-2/3; budgeted seed subset with disclosure

strategy_spec.F2_complexity: per-iteration O(N log N) + O(n k) (Nystrom sketch application), memory O(N + n k); disclosure: this is an O(N log N)-per-iteration family, not an O(N)-exact claim.

win_rules.label_table: SINGLE pre-registration location (hypothesis-gate G2 item 8, carried into iteration-4; rework r2 renames the boundary comparator to DST2): S1' (F1) win iff median free-boundary gap reduction >= 50% (2D+3D pooled) AND median reported residual bound <= 1e-6 (relative system-residual convention, identical in style to the PCG KKT < 1e-6 convention) AND w <= min(H,W)/8 AND >= 50% capture of the DST2 comparator's own gap reduction; REFUTED iff median residual > 1e-6 OR capture < 50%; else NOT-validated (w-guard/rank/scope exceeded) with per-clause reporting. S2' (F2, arm A2) win iff median wall-clock speedup vs standard PCG >= 3x at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 (A2 pooled, RMSE parity on the T1b valid-cell domain); REFUTED iff < 1.5x; 1.5-3x reported NOT-validated as a tie-band case with the written tieband convention. Benchmark (A3) REFUTED iff KISS-GP wins >= 2 domains or dense KRR wins >= 1 domain in RMSE at equal-or-lower cost envelope; ties reported; no cherry-picked exclusions.

s1_prime.win: median free-boundary gap reduction >= 50% (2D+3D pooled) AND median reported relative system residual <= 1e-6 (identical relative convention to the PCG KKT < 1e-6, pre-committed: ||(K + lambda I) alpha_hat - y|| / ||y||) AND w <= min(H,W)/8 on every grid in the pool (structurally enforced via the pre-committed clamp w_design = min(ceil(2.5*rho), min(H,W)/8)) AND capture >= 50% of the DST2 comparator's own gap reduction (secondary DCT/DST consequence, evaluated against DST2 per rework r2; iteration-3 DST2 pooled median reduction 61.62% is INVALIDATED HISTORY, cited as motivation only)
s1_prime.not_validated: if the w-guard is violated despite the clamp OR the rank/scope budget is exceeded (exact band solve still needs more than O(N_b w^2) work/memory on any pool grid), with per-clause reporting
s1_prime.refuted: if the exact band solve still leaves median relative system residual > 1e-6 OR the DST2-capture consequence fails (< 50%)
s1_prime.per_clause_reporting: gap_reduction_pct (median, per grid, pooled), relative_system_residual (median, per grid, pooled), w_guard (per grid), capture_vs_dst2_pct (per grid, pooled), n_neg per grid/kernel, fail_fast rows, reference conventions

s2_prime.win: median wall-clock speedup of the randomized-Nystrom-preconditioned Anderson solver vs standard PCG >= 3x at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 (A2 pooled; per-domain breakdown reported separately) with RMSE parity on the T1b valid-cell domain
s2_prime.tie_not_validated: 1.5-3x reported NOT-validated as a tie-band case under the written tieband convention (ratio of per-domain medians, 0.5% relative analysis band; sensitivity appendix confines verdict flips; iteration-3 template: grf-2d +0.47% at the 0.5% threshold)

benchmark.refuted: iff KISS-GP wins >= 2 of 4 domains OR dense KRR wins >= 1 of 4 domains in RMSE at equal-or-lower cost envelope; ties reported; no cherry-picked exclusions
benchmark.not_refuted: otherwise, with tieband sensitivity reported (iteration-3: kiss_wins=0, dense_wins=0, not-refuted [honest negative])

tieband_convention.definition: per-domain median-RMSE ratio (method_median / best_median - 1), 0.5% relative band, applied uniformly to all domains (iteration-3 analysis operationalization carried forward; NOT a plan number, stated as an analysis convention)
tieband_convention.no_tieband_sensitivity_row: a literal no-tieband row (0.0% band -> strict winner counts) is REQUIRED in the A3 artifact and paper, so verdict flips under the strict reading are visible (iteration-3: grf-2d dense-vs-PCG identical-system tie at 4.85e-07 relative; dense 0.154 s vs PCG 1.714 s; a literal no-tieband reading gives dense_wins=1, flipping grf-2d to REFUTED — this sensitivity MUST be reported)
tieband_convention.uniform_application: the 0.5% band applies to every domain and every method comparison; no per-domain band tuning

win_rules.cost_clause_parse: Win is RMSE-first: a method wins a domain iff its RMSE is best or within the tie band; COST (wall-clock / peak RSS / accuracy-per-flop / accuracy-per-byte) is a CREDIBILITY GATE — a win requires an equal-or-lower cost envelope (dense KRR's O(N^2)/O(N^3) class bound; randomized baselines report approximation error); ties reported; no cherry-picked exclusions. (Locked parse from the analysis gate; not a plan number.)
win_rules.pooling_and_per_domain: The wall-clock pool composition and per-domain breakdowns are stated in the paper (iteration-3 template: 222-row pool of 282, with 60 synthetic block-mask rows carrying no pcg/ssam wall_s; every pooling convention below the 1.5x REFUTED bar — the verdict held under ALL pooling choices; per-domain medians reported). Iteration-4 A2/A3 pools pre-disclose n per row class and per-domain n (grf-2d, grf-3d, mnist, kaplan).
falsification_conditions: residual-tolerance convention IDENTICAL to the PCG KKT < 1e-6 relative convention for BOTH the boundary arm (relative system residual) and the masked arm (KKT residual r_t/||y_m||); matched secondary 1e-8 (T1b canonical per-field residuals 4.69e-9..9.81e-9 at tol 1e-8 are the reference example)

3D floor caveat: 3D symmetric embeddings are non-PSD on the tested kernels (n_neg disclosed per grid/kernel; floored spectrum with a-posteriori floor-error bound per Graham 70); any 3D residual is floor-limited and reported with the caveat, never claimed exact
n_neg disclosure: n_negative_eigenvalues recorded per grid and kernel on every boundary/masked artifact (iteration-3 convention: A1 n_negative_eigenvalues_by_grid)

wall-clock measurement convention: monotonic timestamps around each arm (iteration-2/3 convention; median-of-3 with warm-up excluded where repeated); the 0.1 s rounding disclosure is honored (iteration-3 results_summary: per_arm_elapsed_sum 2296.4 vs measured total 2296.5 s, rounding artifact not a timing error) — iteration-4 summaries carry the same note

Chan 43, Chan-Jin 44, Ng 52, Templates 69. The claim is the grid-KRR-targeted integration + its pre-registered measurement.
no real-SST skill / ENSO-forecast-skill claim anywhere; every empirical number on real data is a reconstruction/efficiency measurement, not a forecast-skill claim.

items.item: no O(N^2)-free claim for arbitrary kernels
items.detail: all O(N log N)/O(N)-memory claims are scoped to the stationary BCCB/BTTB-class on regular grids; no claim for unstructured/arbitrary kernels.

items.item: iteration-3 measured negatives = INVALIDATED HISTORY, honest negatives only
items.detail: every iteration-3 number in this proposal is explicitly attributed as an invalidated-history honest negative (see evidence_base.iter3_honest_negatives_INVALIDATED_HISTORY); none is used as a qualifying claim.
T1b is cited ONLY from results/iter2/T1b-CG-masked-train.json (rate means 245.1/276.1/280.9 @ tol 1e-8, span 233-291, per-field residual 4.69e-9..9.81e-9, RMSE 0.529-0.541).

the pre-fix T1b iteration-count / RMSE figures (the values carrying the SUPERSEDED markers in EXECUTION_NOTES.md and in results/analysis.json masked_training block) are NEVER cited here; only the canonical values from results/iter2/T1b-CG-masked-train.json are used
iteration-3 results_summary.json per_arm_elapsed_sum (2296.4 s) vs measured total (2296.5 s) is a rounding artifact; iteration-4 summaries carry the same rounding-note convention.
results/iter4/A1-boundary.json, A2-masked.json, A3-multidomain.json (identical spelling family to the iteration-3 artifacts; no variant spellings).

iteration-4 artifacts carry dataset.origin and simulation_marker (or null for real Kaplan); simulated-only framing where applicable; h5py route with pre-stated simulated-from-physics fallback (never silent).

peak RSS envelope CLAIM <= 7 GB (project convention), ACTUAL cap ~2 GB cgroup; memory plan sized under ~2 GB; 24^3 dense reference re-attempted only if the cgroup permits, else PCG-1e-8 container-forced deviation disclosed (iteration-3 A1 ref_attempts_log/ref_convention_notes template).

3D symmetric embeddings are empirically non-PSD on the tested kernels (24^3 n_neg {289, 4578, 7662}; 48^3 {0, 1468, 4222}); n_neg recorded per grid/kernel; floored spectrum with a-posteriori floor-error bound (Graham 70); no 3D exactness claim.

kaplan_split.sentinel_rule: h5py missing cells satisfy |x| > 1e30 (53.4% missing); Nino3.4 box rows 17-18 / cols 38-47 (task positioning only)

seeds.note: Kaplan mask sampling and bootstrap use seed 7 (iteration-2/3 convention, preserved); per-domain random-mask draws seeded from it; seeds recorded in every results/iter4 artifact

budget.sum_note: per-arm caps sum exactly to 45 min; disclosure if any arm exceeds its cap (iteration-3 precedent: A1 exceeded its 25-min cap at 1530.3 s and was flagged)
budget.resource_recording: ResourceRecorder (scripts/metrics.py): wall_clock_s via monotonic timestamps per arm; peak_rss_gb via getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss at arm boundaries; est flops/bytes per metrics.py conventions (est_spectral_fit_flops / est_spectral_bytes); peak RSS envelope claim <= 7 GB with the ~2 GB actual cgroup disclosed; iteration-4 summaries carry the 0.1 s rounding-note convention

proposal_final_criteria: one primary strategy (F1) + explicit fallback (F3); F2 documented as contingent secondary (A2)

all win rules falsifiable with pre-committed measurement conventions (relative system residual / KKT < 1e-6 identical convention; w-guard structural clamp; tieband ratio-of-medians 0.5% uniform + literal no-tieband sensitivity row; cost-clause RMSE-first parse; pool + per-domain disclosure; wall-clock convention; n_neg + 3D floor caveat)
